items.name: Herb
items.flavor: A versatile vegetable, found commonly on the floors of the woods. Maybe you could chop this up

items.name: Chopped Herb
items.flavor: All diced up, it's served as toppings on food.

items.name: Fresh Pear
items.flavor: Bright green, atop trees, a fleeting luxury in a forager’s pack.

items.name: Potion of Strength
items.flavor: It burns the throat and makes the heart drum like a war march.

items.name: Potion of Vitality
items.flavor: Cooler than spring water, it washes away the ache of a long journey.

items.name: Potion of Warmth
items.flavor: A liquid hearth for those caught in the bite of a mountain gale.

items.name: Sheep Wool
items.flavor: The smell of high pastures and its fluffiness that keeps warmth in.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.flavor: Heavy and cold to the touch, it holds limitless potential for a craftsman. Maybe you could smelt this

items.name: Copper Ore
items.flavor: Streaked with dull orange, it hums faintly when held near a heat source. Maybe you could smelt this

items.name: Iron Bar
items.flavor: Refined and unyielding, the backbone of any sturdy defense.

items.name: Copper Bar
items.flavor: Gleaming with a soft luster, it conducts both heat and magic with ease.

items.name: Potion of Mending
items.flavor: It knits skin and spirit back together as if the wound were only a dream.

items.name: Potion of Defense
items.flavor: Your skin feels as dense as oak, turning aside all but the fiercest blows.

items.name: Preservation Powder
items.flavor: Fine as stardust, it keeps the rot at bay and the essence fresh.

items.name: Healing Powder
items.flavor: A gritty, glowing dust that stings briefly before the warmth of mending sets in.
